R065 done — **T02 verdict: PASS** (measured, both themes).

## What was wrong
The hour-cell delegate drew `Rectangle { anchors.fill: parent; border.width: 1 }` on every 40px cell, so **each boundary carried two edges** — a cell's bottom border plus its neighbour's top border landed on the same pixel row. Measured: hour lines rendered **2px of (223,225,228)** (blue-tinted, Δ32 from white). Interior day-column separators doubled the same way while the outer edges stayed 1px, so the grid was internally inconsistent — and there were **no half-hour lines at all**.

## The change (`apps/calendar/qml/CalendarScheduleView.qml`, 2 edits)
- New local tokens at **51-58**: `gridLine` (light `#EDEDED` / dark `rgba(1,1,1,0.13)`), `gridLineMinor` (light `#F4F4F4` / dark `rgba(1,1,1,0.06)`). Deliberately *not* `AppTheme.border`, which is app-wide (cards/fields/buttons) — and leaving the all-day band separator on the stronger token preserves the ref's hierarchy there.
- **383-415**: the border box → four bare 1px Rectangles drawing *only their own* top edge (hour line), a mid-cell line at `Math.round(parent.height / 2)` (half-hour), own left edge, and a right edge only on the last column. One line per boundary, so nothing can stack. The `MouseArea` and chip `ColumnLayout` stay in the same Rectangle, declared after the lines.

## Measured
| | light | dark |
|---|---|---|
| hour lines (1px) | **(237,237,237)** at y 205/245/285/325 | **(59,59,59)** |
| half-hour (1px) | **(244,244,244)** at y 225/265/305 | **(43,43,43)** |
| separators (1px) | (237,237,237) at x 52/202/352/502 | 1px |

Alternating 20/20 pitch, correct darker/lighter hierarchy. Dark hour colour is *identical* to the old dark border value → no dark regression, only the 2px→1px fix. Chips still paint above the lines (x=55 = 3px inset from the x=52 separator). Crops: `docs/ui-calendar/r065-grid-light-2x.png`, `r065-grid-dark-2x.png`.

**Ref caveat worth recording:** the ref's hour lines *and* separators are also 1px (237,237,237) — exact colour match — but on a (249,249,249) field while our grid field is pure white, so our contrast reads 7.1% vs the ref's 4.8%. Ref half-hour lines are **not measurable**, so "lighter than hours" is contract-driven (T02), not ref-anchored.

Also corrected two stale rows in `spec.md` (T01 still said `FAIL R063`; R064 fixed it but never updated the table).

**Next round #1:** T03 — gutter label form (font 9 → 10–11, right-aligned 6–8px from the grid instead of centred in the 52px gutter, tick-aligned — the `topMargin: -7` will need recomputing since the CJK line box is 1.47em). Committed as `453ee69`, not pushed.
